Symptom fix: agent cfg-gated the failing tests (via `#[cfg(feature = "xgrammar")]`) without addressing the root cause. The tests are failing because `compile_sync` and async `compile` call `xgrammar_compiler_handle()`, which requires `feature = "xgrammar"` to be enabled at compile time. Under default features (xgrammar OFF), the tests panic on the bail! in the non-xgrammar branch. Gating them away makes the symptoms disappear while the broken code path persists untested.
